description: The can function gives an unknown bool for an index with an unknown key
notes: The README says can returns true if the expression produced a successful result, and an index with an unknown key of a suitable type, which gives an unknown value, evaluates without errors. The core spec says operations on unknown values return unknown values, which could be read as supporting an unknown bool, but also that operations on the dynamic value optimistically assume it will be valid, so the spec doesn't clearly decide. hashicorp/hcl's can (ext/tryfunc/tryfunc.go) gives an unknown bool for a value that isn't wholly known, because the expression could still fail once the value is known.
